name: Wagashiya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood Japanese-sweets shop: a regular-day-off notice, a first day helping make daifuku, a seasonal-sweets price list with a point-card bonus, a limited-edition dorayaki notice, a new-staff training comparison, a customer-preference listening story, a trainee lesson on types of sweet bean paste, an explainer on why a discounted misshapen-sweets corner started, a seasonal gift-set application guide, a column on how gift orders changed the shop's day, a busy-season reception rule, a column on the meaning of a sweets shop's handwork, and a one-year azuki-sourcing cooperation report with a nearby farm. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
